title: Tech Note: Comparison Operators
author: Robert Molina, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Boolean conditional statements and control flow
String, Numeric, Date, Time, and Pointer data type comparisons
Round command for real-number comparison precision

historical_commentary.text: This is a foundational, tutorial-style reference on 4th Dimension's core comparison operators across String, Numeric, Date, Time, and Pointer types, including case/diacritic-insensitive string comparison, the wildcard (@) matching character, and real-number rounding pitfalls. Because these are basic language operators rather than product-specific tooling, virtually everything described remains accurate and directly applicable in current 4D (including within 4D's SQL engine syntax, added in v11/2007, and modern 4D code), making this one of the more evergreen notes in the archive; only the specific documentation URLs cited (4d.com/docs/CMU/...) are certain to be outdated.
related_updates: 4D v11 (2007) later added 4D's native SQL engine, which has its own comparison operator syntax in SQL statements alongside the classic language operators described here
The specific 4D documentation URLs referenced in this note (4d.com/docs/CMU/...) are from the 2006-era doc site structure and are outdated links
